therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation driven by FGFR2 fusions/rearrangements
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with advanced cholangiocarcinoma harboring FGFR2 gene mutations/fusions
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall Response Rate (ORR) as assessed by blinded independent central imaging review

subgroup_findings: Third-line or later therapy showed ORR 28.8% vs 0% after second-line therapy
results.dose_information: Capsule for oral use, specific dose not provided

context.duration: at least 10 months follow-up, median PFS 7.29 months, median OS 11.86 months
context.investigator_commentary: Study was terminated early, formal efficacy analyses only performed for Cohort 1 (FGFR2 fusions), no formal analyses for Cohorts 2 and 3 due to early termination
